sample_limit: 22 个固定 synthetic holdout 样本；区间和分数仅描述此集，不外推至生产或总体泛化。

metric_retrieval_candidate_coverage.method: retrieve_metrics candidate coverage; no planner/model call

interpretation: 完成状态表示双后端执行和逐题一致性检查完成；规则基线错误作为评测结果保留，不折算为执行器通过。

model_ablation.comparison: semantic metric retrieval on vs off; verifier behavior is measured separately on deterministic RulePlanner output
model_ablation.model_backend_scope: SQLite only; PostgreSQL remains covered by deterministic RulePlanner and parity arms
model_ablation.price_basis: existing IP4 v13 preregistration at $0.30/M uncached input and $1.20/M output

request_payload.common_system_prompt: fixed planner instructions and JSON output contract
request_payload.retrieval_on: frozen synthetic question, retrieved static metric definitions and their IDs
request_payload.retrieval_off: same question, empty candidate_metrics and all allowed metric IDs

model_ablation.replay_note: No live-model verifier on/off replay is included. The deterministic no-verifier arm uses RulePlanner and adds no API calls.
